drift_prediction.description: Calibrated uncertainty from real iceberg tracking data
drift_prediction.source: BYU Antarctic Iceberg Tracking Database + evaluation on 2025-26 icebergs

track_extrapolation.description: Constant velocity from recent track (if >= 2 positions available)

uncertainty_km.notes: Calibrated from constant velocity baseline (best performer): Mean=2.19/4.33/6.51 km, using ~75th percentile for conservative bounds

current_based_fallback.description: Physics-based drift with ocean currents (fallback when track unavailable)

uncertainty_km.notes: Calibrated from physics predictor evaluation: Mean=6.19/11.53/16.42 km, using conservative bounds

track_extrapolation_performance.note: Best performer - simple constant velocity from track

current_based_performance.note: Physics-based predictor - useful when track unavailable but less accurate
